vb_textbox.text: There are two colors that go together, purple/green and red/brown. At first click on the different colors to see the number they give. If red is a higher number then choosing purple will also give you a high number. And on the flip side if those numbers start getting lower or even to 0, then choosing green and brown will give the best results. It can start to get inconsistent and every color can give you low numbers but keep trying things until you get a pretty large amount and stick to the color combos: When red is a good number, choose purple. When purple is a good number, choose red. When brown is a good number, choose green. When green is a good number, choose brown.
